integrity: Analytic argument provided with precise saddle localization, multiplicity and threshold bracketing. The 162 numerical diagnostics are supplementary and cannot certify infinite limits or novelty. Scientific self-review performed; no independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only uniformly convex radial weights with uniformly bounded real Hessians and the strictly positive decreasing radial power symbol. Dimension and decay exponent are fixed in the error terms. Does not assert general complex-symbol or nonradial Weyl laws. The broader 2026 Fock-type rearrangement paper could contain implicit prior coverage; its full text was not accessible.
title: A complete radial Weyl criterion for uniformly convex Fock weights
